_comment: The Chifbay look, shared by every Reel (stores/chifbay/reels/make.py) and every photo the robot queues (lib/look.mjs). Measured 2 Oct 2026 against the boat accounts that grow (luxurychartermadeira, giannisboat.capri, frauscherboats): their highlights roll off softly and lean gold, their shadows lean navy, the blacks are slightly lifted like film. Ours were cold and clipped. Change it here only, then rebuild the Reels and let top-up regrade.
name: Atlantic
_comment_grain: Grain is OFF by default (audit, 2 Oct): water already holds fine detail and grain smears after compression. Turn on per asset only after comparing compressed exports.
_comment_v2: v2 (2 Oct 2026, after the audit): one preset per kind of light instead of one push for everything. The scene is measured first (lib/look.mjs, reels/make.py): golden = warm low sun, overcast = low colour, daylight = the rest. Exposure is nudged toward the middle first (at most 4%). Skin, white hull and natural water stay natural; no grain by default (it hurts clarity after Instagram compression).
